rubric.evidence: Binds results to current candidate/inputs and treats prior client-only greens as insufficient for the new contract.

cases.prompt: A docs-only feature branch passed its relevant link check. Repository protection still requires an all-app CI status; that status has not run. The user wants scoped gates in future. Explain delivery now and a reviewable policy improvement; do not run commands or edit protection.

rubric.scope: No automatic deployment or new CI service; respects existing infrastructure and separates policy proposal from applied behavior.

rubric.design: Freezes baseline/candidate bundles and intended changed variables; holds non-target cases/fixtures/protocol/settings/budgets fixed, records each model/provider configuration and reports unavoidable confounds. cases.prompt: Assess this synthetic design only. A state is (parked, jobs, observedIdle), initially (false,0,false). Each action is one serialized command; observation and parking are separate commands. NoProtectedPark forbids parked && jobs>0. An overview merges both (false,0,true) and (false,1,true) into Idle, and shortens Worker.Admit and Admin.Admit to Admit without retaining their qualified IDs. rubric.control: Keeps ordinary controls usable and pins clear of labels/hit areas; does not treat programmatic DOM fill as full native keyboard/accessibility qualification.

rubric.tests: Selects behavioral/focus/accessibility and material pixel regressions under actual owners; no automatic broad product rewrite or baseline acceptance and no duplicate design.md.

cases.prompt: For a consequential new workspace visual direction compare alternatives on the same task, then show the chosen design. An adjacent existing tiny button fix should stay proportional.

rubric.design: Compares genuinely different composition/type/interaction directions rather than recolours, explains concept consequences, renders font-ready primary and relevant failure state, critiques/revises/rechecks.
rubric.evidence: Retains product accessibility and authority; no universal three concepts or iPhone requirement, screenshots only useful visual evidence, no DOM claim of native product qualification.

rubric.durability: Selects consumer repo design owner; saves full source/settings/review and design decisions, verifies actual write/readback and restart at fresh origin with zero comments; browser draft/output cache is insufficient.
rubric.scope: Preserves existing exact-case design document, source/licenses and schema1; does not install skills into target or require a provider.

rubric.stale: Refuses changed geometry/assets/removed target or invalid context; preserves feedback and requires explicit mapping/new round, not silent reseal.

rubric.access: Prominent visible review entry, accessible picker for occluded parts, readable feedback and reduced-motion/manual timeline; no blanket native/full accessibility claim.

cases.prompt: Create an original motion film and explanatory/data/onboarding motion examples. Seek backward and across cuts; I have no Scenario account.

rubric.execution: Uses existing owner and deterministic time-to-frame scenes with actual different content/composition, safe text/captions, explicit FPS/duration/beat spec and tested cut/repeated/backward seeking. No provider or unlicensed source import.
rubric.limits: Does not equate a pulsing title/engine cycle with full film capability. Conditions audio/media/export requirements on actual delivery and reports unrun encode/playback; style-specific high-motion ratios are not universal quality gates.

rubric.validation: Explicit schema/profile boundary, matching strict JS/server types, unknown/duplicate/bounded/nonfinite/source validation before replacement; boolean is not numeric version.
rubric.recovery: Retains original current feedback, uses versioned export/import fallback and honest save errors, avoids copying browser draft state over a newer submitted repo record.

cases.prompt: Trim the first two seconds from this existing MP4 and replace its soundtrack. Do not generate procedural scenes or change the prototype.

rubric.boundary: Uses the existing project media-editing path and does not select technical-illustration or build a kinetic scene merely because the file is a video.

rubric.execution: Uses existing technical-illustration motion-film pipeline with shared model/renderer, source-bound repo-owned fresh output; cut-safe temporal samples, semantic readouts, bounded resources/cancellation and no overwrite.
rubric.evidence: Checks actual H264/yuv420p FPS/duration/dimensions/frame count, AAC when selected, authored caption extraction/timing, decode/faststart/readback and playback. Distinguishes original implementations, 720p full film and short 4K profile evidence; no Scenario/account requirement or blanket parity claim.
